produces: WCAG success-criterion checklist w/ pass/fail per criterion

degree_level_knowledge.concept: WCAG 2.2 success criteria and conformance levels

deliverable_form.method: VPAT/ACR (Accessibility Conformance Report) entry citing the specific WCAG success criteria addressed
deliverable_form.source: ITI VPAT and ACR guidance; deque.com/accessibility-compliance/vpat

feedback_methodology.method: WAI-ARIA authoring-practice check: does an interactive widget expose the correct role/name/state

judgment_methodology.method: WCAG 2.2 success-criterion conformance check (A/AA/AAA) as the pass/fail lens for a UI change

planning_methodology.method: Accessibility heuristics evaluation planned at the design phase, before implementation

quality_bar.verification_method: ACT-Rules-conformant automated scanner run against the WCAG-EM sample, zero violations asserted
cross-reference the manual-check log against the WCAG-EM criterion list for the sample, asserting every ACT-Rules not-machine-testable criterion has a recorded pass/fail/n-a outcome
automated keyboard-nav + focus-visibility check across the sample
automated accessibility-tree query against the sample, asserting non-empty accessible name/role (and value/state where applicable) on every interactive element

gates/quality_bar.py:human_comprehensibility_verdict against the role's own docs/issue-<n>/reports/<role>.md record text (gates/human_comprehensibility.py tier-1 structural prose rules: lead paragraph present, citation trailing placement, section size bound, no raw dump, enumeration cap); a record with no human-facing prose section anywhere is exempt (bar-met) -- issue #1623.

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: overall verdict = the worst-case result across all cited sample x test outcomes (failed > cantTell > untested > inapplicable > passed), never a standalone summary field (issue-515 invariant 4). result uses ACT's 5-value outcome enum, not EARL's 4-value one, since ACT is the accessibility-specific profile and the W3C spec frames ACT-EARL compatibility as expressibility, not identity (scout-brief.md).

reference_resolution.rule: sample entries must resolve to real screens/components/tokens in the repo; test must be bound to a specific WCAG success-criterion ID (e.g. '1.4.3') — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

review_methodology.method: WCAG 2.2 conformance re-check against the specific success criteria the change touches (perceivable/operable/understandable/robust)

record_spec.source_standard: WCAG-EM 2.0 (W3C, https://www.w3.org/TR/wcag-em/) evaluation procedure + ACT Rules Format outcome vocabulary (W3C, https://www.w3.org/TR/act-rules-format/)

use_when.board_condition: a new interaction pattern or color-token set landed on the branch AND no accessibility record exists yet for it

use_when: 신규 인터랙션 패턴·색상 토큰 도입 시 (board_condition: a new interaction pattern or color-token set landed on the branch AND no accessibility record exists yet for it)
